task.description: WF-03 step 1, ISSUE-FIXER, defect ISS-0132 (HIGH): on Windows the team engine and Pixel Office run without a guard (the group stop `process.kill(-pid)` does nothing, so a cancel or timeout of a real run does not end it; the modes 0700/0600, the owner check and O_NOFOLLOW do nothing). The fix direction is set by decisions/0127 Г and 0134 item 4: fail closed on win32, never port. Do the five points of WF-03 step 1: (1) similar closed defects; (2) reproduce by reading AND by a probe you write yourself under <scratch> that calls the real functions with a harmless child (for example `node -e "setInterval(()=>{},1000)"`) and shows that the group stop leaves it alive on this PC, and that a mode set to 0700 reads back otherwise; kill your child by its exact pid afterwards and show it is gone; (3) the cause; (4) EVERY place of the same kind in tools/src (grep `process.kill(-`, `chmod`, `0o700`, `0o600`, `getuid`, `O_NOFOLLOW`, `/bin/sh`, `spawn(` with `detached`), each with file:line and whether it is reachable on win32; name the entry points that would start a real run or write a state folder (the team web server, the team CLI, the Pixel Office server and hook, the picker) and which one must refuse; (5) what must change: one guard function with an injectable platform (where it lives, its name, its refusal code and message in Russian and English like the other refusals of the tools, which entry points call it, what the README says), and the tests that prove it on Linux with the platform injected. Fix nothing. Name what must be proved on GitHub (`must_be_proved_on_github`). Be economical. result.summary: Diagnosis of ISS-0132 (WF-03 step 1), on tools/src identical to the tag base/ISS-0132-20261123-01 (d9104a3; git diff of tools/src and tools/README.md against the tag is empty). CONFIRMED by an own probe on this Windows PC (Node 22.23.4, win32) that imports the real functions. CAUSE: the team core and Pixel Office are written for POSIX only and never ask the platform (no `process.platform` anywhere in tools/src). Each POSIX mechanism has a silent fallback that turns into 'pass' on win32 instead of a refusal: (a) the group stop - `process.kill(-pid, sig)` in signalGroup and `process.kill(-pid, 0)` in groupAlive (tools/src/team/executors/proc.js:16, :26) throw ESRCH on win32 for a living child (there are no process groups; a negative pid names no process), the catch reads ESRCH as 'the group is gone', so stopGroup returns true after 0 ms and no SIGTERM or SIGKILL is ever sent; `detached: true` in executors/claude-cli.js:212 makes a new console on win32, not a group; (b) modes - mkdir/open with 0700/0600 and chmodSync/fchmodSync succeed without error and the mode reads back 0666; nothing re-reads the mode after a chmod, so team/home.js ensureHome even reports «Права папки данных сужены до 0700 (были 0666)» on every call - a false statement; (c) the owner check - `typeof process.getuid === 'function' ? ... : null` and `uid === null || st.uid === uid` make every folder 'own' on win32; (d) `fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW` is undefined on win32 and becomes flag 0 (by `?? 0` or by `| undefined`), so the open follows a link (an lstat check before it remains). EFFECT on win32 (by reading claude-cli.js run(), on top of the probe): on a timeout, a cancel or too much output stop() calls stopGroup, which says 'gone' at once; the 'close' of the child never comes while it runs, so the real run goes on until Claude Code ends by itself (the owner's money, G2); state.groupStuck stays false, so the result is not marked FAIL_DETAIL.group, the retry rule of README «Repeats, timeout and processes» (the next attempt only after the group is stopped) is broken, and after an exit (claude-cli.js:345) leftovers are never stopped. The control channel of a running engine (team/engine/channel.js:202, :367, :437, :624 require the mode to EQUAL 0600/0700) can never accept a message on win32 (modes read 0666), so say/pause/stop to a running engine fail too. The trust of the README («rights 0700», files 0600) holds nothing on win32; the README names no platform. WHY THE TESTS DID NOT CATCH IT: every check runs on GitHub ubuntu-24.04 only (.github/workflows/check.yml:18), where these mechanisms work; no test injects a platform, and no requirement criterion names the supported platforms (the expected behaviour lives only in decisions/0127 Г and 0134 item 4). WHAT MUST CHANGE (behaviour, not code): one pure guard module with an injectable platform, called first by every entry point of the team core and of Pixel Office and inside the real executor's own check (protection in the same operation); the thin-client tools (traces, handoffs-check, handoff, prepare-run/validate/apply-verdict/snapshot, picker, office-report) must keep working on Windows; recommended: the folder writers re-read the mode after a chmod and refuse when it is still wider; the README names Linux and macOS as the only run hosts and Windows as a client. Details, the full list of places and the tests: issues I1-I9. Nothing in the project was changed; the probe and its folders lie in <scratch>.

issues.text: No closed defect has the same cause (a POSIX mechanism that passes silently on win32), so this is not a return of an earlier fix. Related, not the same: ISS-0103 (closed 2026-11-03; the e2e kit checked the group gone too early - a timing cause on Linux); ISS-0107 (open; a group number stays registered in the e2e kit - Linux, tests only); ISS-0099 (open, LOW; item 3: the full check cannot run on Windows because 38 test files use modes or links - the same platform fact at the level of the tests, no guard in the tools); ISS-0134 (open, the same audit AUD-002; the traces check is blind to Windows paths - the same 'Windows never named' gap, another place). AP-078 (the tests never ran on the target platform) is the nearest mistake-log entry.

All in tools/src (the tag), with reachability on win32. A - group stop: team/executors/proc.js:16 signalGroup kill(-pid,sig) [reachable: claude-cli stop(); probe: ESRCH, no signal sent]; proc.js:26 groupAlive kill(-pid,0) [always false; probe: stopGroup true after 0 ms, child alive]; team/executors/claude-cli.js:207-213 spawn detached:true [win32: new console, no group]; claude-cli.js:231 stop()->stopGroup and :345 the leftovers check after exit [never stop anything]. Not of the kind: team/lock.js:44 and traces/add.js:164 process.kill(pid,0) with a positive pid (works on win32); handoffs/git-history.js and traces/git-files.js execFileSync git (no group, no detached). B - trust in 0700/0600: team/home.js:83-84, :152, :161 ensureHome (probe: 0666 after; false notice «сужены до 0700»), :138 wider, :184 inspectHome (warns always), :239-289 project modes (narrowed again on each write); team/store.js:626-639 project folder 0700 and files 0600; team/files.js:100 result files 0600; team/lock.js:184 lock 0600; team/engine/channel.js:178 (write 0600), :202, :367, :437, :609, :624 (strict equality with 0600/0700: on win32 the channel never accepts a message - by reading and the probe's 0666); pixel-office/state-dir.js:77, :98-100 ensureStateDir (probe: 0666 after chmod, no read-back, no refusal), :174, :186 secret 0600, :221-223 secret narrowed on each read, :281-282 small files 0600; pixel-office/journal.js:69 events 0600. Reachable through team, team-web, pixel-office (and note/hook read the 0600 secret). Not of the kind: handoffs/create.js:209 0o644 and traces/add.js:177 0o600 (repository files, no privacy trust), util.js:292, :316 (apply-verdict keeps the mode of the edited file). C - owner check: team/home.js:90-96 ownUid/isOwn, team/engine/channel.js:111-117 ownUid/isOwn, pixel-office/state-dir.js:92 (skipped) - on win32 every folder is 'own'. D - O_NOFOLLOW becomes 0 on win32: with `?? 0` pixel-office/journal.js:37, pixel-office/state-dir.js:30, pixel-office/server.js:79, web/server.js:66, team/files.js:12, team/journal.js:17, picker/assets.js:14, picker/load.js:125; without `?? 0` (`| undefined` = 0) team/engine/channel.js:99 (used at :209, :375, :632), team/executors/scripted.js:36 (:182), team/runner.js:49, handoffs/check.js:60, traces/check.js:49. Everywhere an lstat/isSymbolicLink check comes first, so a link present at the check is refused; only a link swapped in between the check and the open is followed (a race). For team and Pixel Office this is covered by the entry refusal; for handoffs/check.js, traces/check.js and the picker it is a residual LOW (repository files, tools that must keep running on the thin client) - not widened here. E - /bin/sh: pixel-office/hook.sh:1 (#!/bin/sh launcher with macOS fallbacks; reachable only if the owner installs the hook on Windows and Claude Code runs it through a POSIX shell); hook.js:86-89 reads the secret and the port and posts - writes nothing. F - spawn with detached: only claude-cli.js:207-213 (see A).

Scripts of tools/package.json and what each must do on win32. MUST REFUSE: `team` (team/cli.js main, right after refuseBelowNodeFloor at :453; writes the data folder, start/resume/run-task start a real run) - exit 2; `team-web` (web/main.js, before resolveHome and listen; creates projects, resumes engines, real runs) - exit 2; `pixel-office` (pixel-office/main.js run, before resolveStateDir :196 and ensureStateDir :211) - exit 1, as for its floor refusal; `pixel-office-note` (pixel-office/note.js; reads the 0600 secret, signs and posts; writes nothing) - exit 2 (it trusts a secret whose mode means nothing). MUST DROP SILENTLY: the hook (hook.sh -> hook.js run(), before resolveStateDir :86) - exit 0, prints nothing, reads and sends nothing (the session must not notice). DEFENCE IN THE SAME OPERATION: claude-cli.js check() (:114) - the first condition; it is called by run() itself, by team/runner.js:254, team/engine/engine.js:177 (preflight) and team/engine/single-run.js:191, so every path to a real process is covered even if an entry guard is missed. MUST NOT REFUSE (the thin client of decisions/0127 Г; the owner's rules run them on this PC): `prepare-run`, `validate`, `apply-verdict`, `snapshot`, `snapshot-diff` (src/cli.js), `traces`, `handoffs-check`, `handoff`, `picker` (no state folder, no spawn, no modes), and pixel-office/public/office-report.js (reads a journal file only). The scripted executor spawns nothing, but the team core with it still writes the folders of B/C, so the refusal is per entry point, not per executor.

For CODE-DESIGNER (what, not how). Where: a new pure module tools/src/platform-guard.js beside node-floor.js and in the same pattern (loads no module, reads neither disk nor environment; process.platform only as the default of an argument, so a test passes any platform). Names: SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS = ['linux', 'darwin'] (an allow-list: win32, cygwin, freebsd, '', undefined and anything else are refused - fail closed); isSupportedPlatform(platform = process.platform); platformRefusal(platform) - the one-line text; refuseUnsupportedPlatform(stderr, platform = process.platform) - false and stderr untouched when supported, else one write of the line and true (a write that throws is swallowed), like refuseBelowNodeFloor. Refusal code: E_PLATFORM - a row of EXECUTOR_MESSAGES in team/errors.js (thrown by claude-cli check() with io.platform ?? process.platform), a row of PREFLIGHT_CODES in web/api.js:337 and of WHY_NOT_STARTED in web/texts.js; at the entries the exit codes of I3. Text (Russian, as every refusal of the tools; the README gives the English gloss in brackets as it does for other Russian lines): «Sai Team и Pixel Office работают только на Linux и macOS, а запущены на win32: команда остановлена, ничего не записано и не запущено. Windows — только клиент; подробности — tools/README.md, раздел «Platforms».» (Sai Team and Pixel Office run on Linux and macOS only, and this is win32: the command is stopped, nothing is written or started. Windows is a client only; details in tools/README.md, section «Platforms».) The platform is shown only in a safe shape (as SHOWN_SHAPE of node-floor.js), else «неизвестная платформа». Executor row: «Настоящие запуски на этой системе запрещены: только Linux и macOS (Windows — только клиент)». Order: after the node-floor guard; `--help` and a wrong call may be answered as for the floor (they write nothing; keeps NF-08 consistent) - the designer decides and writes it. Recommended (the defect's item 1, 'refuse to write the state folder when the modes cannot be set'): ensureHome (team/home.js) and ensureStateDir (pixel-office/state-dir.js) re-read the mode after a chmod and refuse (E_HOME / E_STATE_DIR) when it is still wider - platform-independent (also a FAT or network mount on Linux/macOS), and it removes the false notice «сужены до 0700»; if the designer leaves it out, it is a new defect, not this one widened. README: a section «Platforms» next to «Check»: the team core (core, executors, engine, interface) and Pixel Office (server, hook, note) run on Linux and macOS only; on Windows these commands stop with one line (codes of I3; the hook drops the event silently); Windows is a thin client (documents, site code, traces, handoffs-check, handoff, the picker check), the checks run on GitHub (decisions/0110), the worker runs in a Linux container (decisions/0134 item 4); and one clause each at :147 and :251 that the 0700/0600 rights hold on Linux and macOS. Porting (a win32 branch with taskkill /T, ACLs) is out of scope by decisions/0127 Г and 0134 item 4.

For TEST-DESIGNER, all on Linux with the platform injected, nothing real on Windows. PG-1 unit of the module: linux and darwin accepted; win32, cygwin, freebsd, aix, '', undefined, a hostile text refused; the line is one line, no stack, no control character, names the platform or «неизвестная платформа»; a stderr that throws does not change the result. PG-2 executor: claude-cli check(request, {config: {realRuns: true}, platform: 'win32'}) with a budget and a good work folder throws E_PLATFORM first; run() with an io.spawn spy under 'win32' never calls spawn; under 'linux' check() goes on to the next rule (positive control). PG-3 entries: team, team-web, pixel-office, pixel-office-note started under an --import preload that redefines process.platform to 'win32' (the pattern of the version preload of NF-05b) with HOME, SAI_TEAM_HOME and SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR pointing into a fresh temp folder: each ends with its code (2/2/1/2), empty stdout, exactly the refusal line on stderr, the temp folder stays empty, no port file, nothing listens; the same preload with 'linux' gives the normal start (a server reaches its link line) - the positive control of the preload. PG-4 hook: hook.js under the 'win32' preload with a valid state folder and a stub listener: exit 0, empty stdout and stderr, nothing received by the stub. PG-5 thin client: traces, handoffs-check, handoff --help, picker --help and the src/cli.js commands under the 'win32' preload are NOT refused (a guard against over-blocking). PG-6 web texts: E_PLATFORM has a row in PREFLIGHT_CODES and WHY_NOT_STARTED (a page reply names the platform reason, not «внутренняя ошибка»). PG-7 (if the read-back is designed): ensureHome/ensureStateDir with an injected fs whose chmod changes nothing are refused and no notice «сужены» is given. Mutants to be caught: the guard call dropped from each entry; dropped from claude-cli check(); the allow-list replaced by a deny-list of 'win32'; an exit code changed; the read-back removed. The regression run that must FAIL before the fix (a fresh clone of the tag): PG-2 (no E_PLATFORM: check() under 'win32' passes and spawn is called) and PG-3 (under the 'win32' preload each entry starts and writes its folder). The probe above is the Windows-side proof of the defect; the tests prove the refusal branch only.

The expected behaviour (fail closed on win32; the supported platforms) is written only in decisions/0127 Г and 0134 item 4 and in the defect, not in a criterion of REQ-013, REQ-035, REQ-011, REQ-001 or REQ-005 and not in a test, so WF-03 step 2 is needed: REQ-ANALYST adds one criterion (suggested home: REQ-110, the requirement of the tools' entry guard, which already lists every entry point with its exit code; or one criterion each in REQ-013 for the executor and REQ-001 for Pixel Office), REQ-VALIDATOR checks it. docs/requirements.yaml is now written by the parallel run M2ACCT-20261123-01 lane-a: ORCH serializes this edit after it.

Keep HIGH. A real run is reachable on this PC by the documented path (SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS=1, a budget above 0, Claude Code installed), and then a timeout or a cancel does not stop it (proved: stopGroup says 'gone' after 0 ms while the child lives) - the owner's money under G2 (Q10: a stop that does not stop). The mode/owner part alone would be MEDIUM (a single-user PC, Q7). Not a return of an earlier defect (I1).

Q13, a process mistake behind the code: «A protection that depends on the operating system falls back silently to 'pass' where it cannot work» - a group signal whose ESRCH means 'gone', `getuid` absent -> 'own', `O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0`, a chmod never read back; the supported platforms were never named in a requirement and every check runs on one OS, so no test could see it. Lesson: name the run hosts in the requirement, refuse every other one at the entry and in the protected operation, and read a protection back after setting it. Adds to AP-078. The number is given by DOC-UPDATER.

The task asks for the refusal 'in Russian and English like the other refusals of the tools'. The refusals of the tools are Russian only (node-floor.js nodeFloorRefusal, team/errors.js tables, web/texts.js); English appears only as the gloss in tools/README.md. I4 therefore gives the Russian line with its English gloss for the README; if ORCH wants a bilingual stderr line, that departs from the existing refusals and should be said in the design. The facts of the defect were checked (AP-012): 'group gone after 0 ms while the process kept running' and 'mode 666 after chmod 700' are both confirmed exactly by this probe.
